summary: A clean tactical turn: Mahmoud spots the guns traversing, and Shalabi answers with an immediate protective order. Both lines are short, playable over the engines, and appropriate to rank and danger.

lines.speaker: MAHMOUD
issues: The internal sukun in «بِيْلِفُّوا» is unnecessary; «بِيلِفُّوا» is cleaner vocalization.

performance.delivery: Mahmoud snaps his attention toward Shalabi and projects over the engines. Report exactly what he sees without letting fear turn into panic.
Shalabi throws the order down the line in one clipped burst. Strike «كُلُّهْ» and «حُفْرِتُهْ» hard; keep «يَلَّا» short, not theatrical.
